svg.title: DeltaV Operate · Configure
svg.desc: Color-coded relationship map. Named containers show organization. Arrow labels describe creation, containment, references or calls. Select a card in the HTML atlas for its explanation and parser implications.
svg.text: Saved configuration model · functional groups, not a screenshot of the application
Native files / VBA projects → Configure tools → saved pictures → station content → runtime
Source graphics and code; functional grouping
Saved graphic content and navigation behavior

g.title: Dynamo sets provide source dynamos for placement into pictures. Associated forms/scripts/events can be copied with the placed dynamo, but VBA modules, class modules and external control/DLL references are not automatically copied by that operation.

text.tspan: Source dynamos placed into pictures
Associated code/forms may move; dependencies may not

g.title: An existing picture or site starter can provide initial layout and content for another picture. Operate layouts and screen/navigation assets also need assessment. Their exact structure is site/version dependent; they are not automatically equivalent to Live templates or display sets.

text.tspan: Common initial content and screen arrangement
Source copies / conventions are not Live class links

g.title: The documented converter maps global variables to Live standards and color tables to functions. This is a conversion rule for supported graphics content, not proof that every mutable VBA global can become a standard with identical behavior.

text.tspan: Appearance rules and referenced configuration data
Separate configuration constants from mutable state

g.title: Picture/object code and shared projects such as User.fxg can participate in calls to helpers and UserForms. External OCX/COM/DLL references and other files can also matter. A Configure form edits graphics; a Run form interacts with the running operator environment.

text.tspan: Picture / object code; User.fxg and shared helpers
UserForms · modules · references · OCX / DLL / files

g.title: Process pictures, faceplates, detail pictures and custom popup pictures have their own configuration. Runtime VBA UserForms are a different kind of UI artifact even if operators also experience them as windows.

text.tspan: Process · faceplate · detail · custom popup pictures
Runtime VBA UserForms are a separate UI artifact

g.title: A picture can contain shapes, text, groups, data links, placed dynamos and supported ActiveX controls. Properties and animations may have been changed after placement or generated by a dynamo’s edit form.

text.tspan: Shapes · text · groups · data links · dynamos · ActiveX
Actual instance settings, bindings and local changes

g.title: Screen arrangement, headers, toolbars and picture-opening behavior contribute to the Operate operator workspace. Live separates these responsibilities across layouts, frames, display sets and interactions. This is a redesign/mapping area, not a universal file-to-file correspondence.

text.tspan: Screen arrangement and picture-opening behavior
Map responsibilities; no universal Display Set equivalent

g.title: Clicks, open events, animation expressions, timers or schedules trigger different behavior. Shared procedures execute when called. Context may be explicit arguments or values read from other objects/globals.

text.tspan: Click / open / timer / schedule → handler or expression
Configure-time edits versus Run-time reads / writes

svg.text: These tools expose or execute configuration; they are not additional copies of every graphic.

g.title: Operate tools create graphics and place reusable dynamos into pictures. This is comparable to the authoring role of the Live Palette, not an assertion that their catalogs or object APIs are identical.

text.tspan: Creates shapes and other objects
Places reusable dynamos
Saved picture holds the result

g.title: Property dialogs, Experts and dynamo forms configure appearance and behavior. Dynamo forms may execute VBA to rewrite contained shape properties. The effect of that code is part of the migration requirement.

text.tspan: Properties · Experts · dynamo forms
VBA can rewrite child properties
Capture both rule and resulting state

g.title: Running pictures load the applicable files and dependencies. A picture’s existence in a backup or source folder does not establish the version loaded on a workstation. Distribution arrangements vary by site.

text.tspan: Files + required shared dependencies
Loaded picture has runtime behavior
Controller execution is separate

svg.text: Read arrows by their labels. The card inspector supplies additional relationships without drawing every dependency across the page.
